## Performance

- Startup no longer scans the database. Integrity verification moved into a background read-only subprocess, so an unclean shutdown no longer delayed the server before it could accept requests (measured: 77s on a 5.3 GB database)
- A database that cannot be repaired automatically now stops retrying on every boot instead of blocking startup for minutes and leaving a full-size backup behind each time
- Storage scanning on the settings page now measures tables in parallel worker threads, keeping the main thread responsive during the scan; the cleanup preview no longer loads every candidate row into memory
- Added foreign-key covering indexes so deleting a chapter, narrator or message no longer scans whole tables
- Narrator message cards now update in place when a tool finishes or a reflection resolves, instead of refetching the tail — scroll position is preserved while browsing history during active generation
- Diff bodies are computed once and cached, and only render the rows a scroll box can reach, removing hundreds of milliseconds of recomputation and thousands of invisible DOM nodes

## New Features

- Sessions no longer expire out from under an active user: a token close to expiry is renewed transparently, capped at 30 days from the original login so an abandoned or stolen token still dies
- Session tokens are now revocable before they expire. An administrator password reset ends every session opened with the old password, and sessions can be revoked on their own for a lost device
- Role changes now take effect immediately rather than persisting until the old token expires

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed being unable to delete a user who had ever opened a terminal tab (the request failed with a foreign-key error)
- Fixed "execution target is already frozen" when resuming a tool call after a planned update, and a re-run whose target drifted (for example a remote device reconnecting with a different working directory) is now refused instead of executing somewhere that was never approved
- Fixed a phantom approval form appearing on recovered subagent cards while the work was already running
- Fixed finished tool cards being pushed back into a running state by events replayed after a reconnect
- Fixed a subagent card clipping away its recent-call rows because the cached height predated them
- Fixed structural updates never being applied during continuous generation
- Fixed a storage report showing zeros instead of reporting that some tables could not be read during maintenance
- Fixed a long unbreakable line in a slash-command bubble being truncated with no way to expand it
zh-CN:
## 性能优化

- 启动不再扫描数据库。完整性校验改为后台只读子进程执行，非正常关机后不会再阻塞服务器接受请求（实测 5.3 GB 数据库耗时 77 秒）
- 无法自动修复的数据库不再每次启动重试，避免了反复几分钟的启动阻塞和每次留下一份整库备份
- 设置页的存储扫描改为多个工作线程并行测量表，扫描期间主线程保持响应；清理预览不再把全部候选行读进内存
- 补齐外键覆盖索引，删除章节、叙述者或消息不再全表扫描
- 叙述者消息卡片在工具完成或反思结束时就地更新，不再重新拉取尾部消息——生成过程中翻阅历史不会被拽回底部
- Diff 内容只计算一次并缓存，且只渲染滚动区域能看到的行，省去数百毫秒的重复计算和数千个不可见 DOM 节点

## 新功能

- 活跃使用时会话不会突然失效：临近过期的令牌会自动续期，但以首次登录起 30 天为上限，被弃用或泄露的令牌仍会到期失效
- 会话令牌现在可以提前撤销。管理员重置密码会终止用旧密码建立的所有会话，也可以在不改密码的情况下单独撤销会话（比如设备丢失）
- 角色变更立即生效，不再需要等旧令牌自然过期

## 修复

- 修复开过终端标签页的用户无法删除的问题（请求会因外键约束失败）
- 修复计划更新后恢复工具调用时报「执行目标已冻结」的问题；执行目标发生漂移的重跑（例如远程设备重连后工作目录变了）现在会被拒绝，而不是在未经批准的位置执行
- 修复恢复后的子代理卡片上出现幽灵审批表单、而实际工作已在运行的问题
- 修复重连后重放的事件会把已完成的工具卡片打回运行状态的问题
- 修复子代理卡片因缓存高度早于最近调用行而把这些行裁掉的问题
- 修复持续生成时结构性更新永远不会被应用的问题
- 修复维护期间部分表无法读取时，存储报告显示为 0 而不提示数据不完整的问题
- 修复斜杠指令气泡中过长的不可断行内容被截断且无法展开的问题
